description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, targeting Goldspan Dragon.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Goldspan Dragon each trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving Goldspan Dragon +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
